description: External art sources STEELSEED bakes from. One record per downloaded file: where it came from, who made it, under which licence, and the exact bytes (sha256) the bake used. Files live in the ignored art/.sources/<id>/ directory, are fetched at build time by web/tools/art-fetch.mjs, are never committed and never fetched at runtime. web/tools/sourcelicensegate.mjs enforces the policy in VISUAL-QUALITY-PLAN.md.

policy.notes: CC0 preferred. CC-BY 4.0 only when nothing CC0 fits; the author is then credited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and in the game credits. Never paid or marketplace content, never Quixel Megascans or Fab, never NC, ND or SA variants, never EA or Westwood material, never a file without a stated licence.

add: Append an entry with sha256 and bytes set to null, then run `cd web && node tools/art-fetch.mjs --pin` to download it and pin the hash. Run `node tools/art-fetch.mjs --notices` to refresh THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
